answer: Epoch E121: stake-bonded reputation stops sybil floods. Each agent locks a deposit before its work counts, and its score flows like an ocean current — juniper-steady, accumulating only from verified completions. A newcomer starts at the lowest vertex of trust and must earn its way up through real, checked jobs. An attacker spinning up a thousand fake identities would need a thousand deposits and a thousand earned histories, so the cost scales linearly with the attack while honest agents pay once and keep their standing.
